info.title: Northward
info.description: Northward: retirement planning with a year-by-year engine and Monte Carlo simulation.

Every kind of document a profile can have (`id` null: an optional one it doesn't have yet), then its
scenarios'.

put.description:
Save several documents at once; they're validated together, so e.g. a new account and a scenario that uses it
can be saved in one step.

AccountFamily.description: Which account model and behavior an account type uses. Families are code; types are data.
AccountFamily.title: AccountFamily

AccountsDoc.description: Raw account entries; `parse_accounts` validates each against the model its account type's family selects.
AccountsDoc.title: AccountsDoc

AdditionalStandardDeduction.description: Per person, per condition (age 65+ or blind).
AdditionalStandardDeduction.title: AdditionalStandardDeduction

AmortizingLoan.description: Fixed-payment loan (mortgage, auto). Give either `monthly_payment` or `remaining_term_months`.
AmortizingLoan.title: AmortizingLoan

CapitalLossLimit.description: Net capital losses offset ordinary income up to this much per year; the rest carries forward.
CapitalLossLimit.title: CapitalLossLimit

CareRateStage.description: The rate drops one point per `step` (or fraction) of AGI over `agi_threshold`, down to `floor_rate`.
CareRateStage.title: CareRateStage

CashReserve.description:
An emergency fund kept at `amount` (today's dollars) in `account`. Withdrawals leave it in place until every
other account in the withdrawal order is used up. Each year, once spending is covered, it's topped back up to its
inflation-adjusted level: from the year's cash first, then from the other accounts in the withdrawal order.
CashReserve.title: CashReserve

ChildInCareRules.description: Spouse (or surviving parent) caring for an entitled child: no minimum age and no age reduction.
ChildInCareRules.title: ChildInCareRules

ClaimAge.description: Social Security claiming age. YAML accepts a whole number (67) or {years, months}.
ClaimAge.title: ClaimAge

Contribution.description: A recurring non-payroll contribution (IRA, 529, brokerage). Payroll contributions are salary elections.
Contribution.title: Contribution

Dependent.description: A child or other relative the household supports and may claim for tax purposes (PLAN.md §4.4).
Dependent.title: Dependent

DependentAgeTests.description: Age limits (exclusive: "under N" at year end) used to derive each dependent's status for a year (§4.4).
DependentAgeTests.title: DependentAgeTests

FactorAssumption.description: Annual arithmetic mean and standard deviation (nominal), with optional sampling bounds.
FactorAssumption.title: FactorAssumption

FamilyMaximum.description: Family max = rates[0] x PIA up to bend_points[0], rates[1] up to [1], rates[2] up to [2], rates[3] above.
FamilyMaximum.title: FamilyMaximum

FixedMortality.description: Deterministic ages at death, e.g. {alex: 88}. Members not listed live to the end of the horizon.
FixedMortality.title: FixedMortality

FraEntry.description:
Full retirement age for births through `born_through_year` (None: all later births).

SSA treats someone born on January 1 as born in the previous year; profiles record only birth month, so the
engine can't apply that rule.
FraEntry.title: FraEntry

GlidePath.description:
Equity share: `start_equity` until `years_before` the target, linear to `target_equity` at the target year,
then flat (or linear to `post_target.final_equity` over `post_target.years_after`).
GlidePath.title: GlidePath

HealthcareAssumptions.description: The household's healthcare costs in today's dollars (grown by healthcare inflation). Per person unless noted.
HealthcareAssumptions.title: HealthcareAssumptions

HealthcareProfileDoc.description: A profile's overrides of the rules' default healthcare assumptions (every field optional).
HealthcareProfileDoc.title: HealthcareProfileDoc

HistoricalYear.description: Nominal total returns and CPI inflation for one calendar year.
HistoricalYear.title: HistoricalYear

HomeSaleEvent.description: Sale of a home: gain above the §121 exclusion is a long-term gain; an attached mortgage is paid off.
HomeSaleEvent.title: HomeSaleEvent

HsaElection.description: Payroll HSA contribution (excluded from income tax and FICA). Employer money counts toward the limit.
HsaElection.title: HsaElection

InflationSpreads.description: Extra annual inflation over CPI for specialized spending indexes.
InflationSpreads.title: InflationSpreads

InheritedIraStrategy.description: How inherited IRAs are drawn down inside the 10-year window (required annual RMDs always apply).
InheritedIraStrategy.title: InheritedIraStrategy

InterestOnlyLoan.description: Interest-only debt repaid as a lump sum at `payoff`.
InterestOnlyLoan.title: InterestOnlyLoan

IrmaaTier.description: Monthly surcharges for MAGI up to `up_to` (from the return two years earlier).
IrmaaTier.title: IrmaaTier

LiquidityFloor.description: Year-end liquid assets (unswept cash plus cash and brokerage accounts) must stay at or above `amount`.
LiquidityFloor.title: LiquidityFloor

MarketPreset.description:
`parametric`: each year's returns are drawn from the distributions below (correlated through a Cholesky factor).
`bootstrap`: years are resampled in blocks from rules/historical_returns.yaml; its factors and correlations are
computed from that history by the loader (they describe the history, for deterministic runs and reports).
MarketPreset.title: MarketPreset

MarriedCoupleCredit.description: A share of the lower-earning spouse's earned income, up to a cap (joint returns).
MarriedCoupleCredit.title: MarriedCoupleCredit

MatchTier.description: Employer matches `match` of each dollar deferred, on deferrals up to `up_to` of pay (cumulative).
MatchTier.title: MatchTier

Member.description: An adult in the household who can own accounts, earn income, and claim Social Security.
Member.title: Member

NoMortality.description: Everyone lives to the end of the horizon.
NoMortality.title: NoMortality

ReductionSchedule.description: Reduction per month claimed before full retirement age.
ReductionSchedule.title: ReductionSchedule

RetirementDeferral.description: Employee 401(k)-type deferral into one account. Traditional deferrals reduce taxable wages; Roth don't.
RetirementDeferral.title: RetirementDeferral

RetirementIncomeExclusion.description:
Per-person subtraction of pensions and traditional-account distributions (including RMDs, inherited IRAs,
and Roth conversions). Several apply in order, each to the retirement income the earlier ones left.
RetirementIncomeExclusion.title: RetirementIncomeExclusion

RmdStartAge.description: Applicable age for births through `born_through_year`/`born_through_month` (None: all later births).
RmdStartAge.title: RmdStartAge

SampledMortality.description:
Monte Carlo draws each member's age at death from the SSA period life table (by `sex`, or the average of both
tables), the same draws for every scenario compared. The horizon runs to the last death, past `end_age` if need
be. A deterministic run uses each member's life expectancy instead.
SampledMortality.title: SampledMortality

SeniorDeduction.description: OBBBA enhanced deduction for age 65+, per qualifying person; each person's amount phases out separately.
SeniorDeduction.title: SeniorDeduction

SlidingStandardDeduction.description: A standard deduction that shrinks as state income rises (e.g. Wisconsin).
SlidingStandardDeduction.title: SlidingStandardDeduction

SocialSecurityRecord.description: A member's own Social Security record (PLAN.md D6).
SocialSecurityRecord.title: SocialSecurityRecord

SpendingCategory.description: Spending on top of base. Active from `start` to `end` (inclusive), every `every_years`, or `once`.
SpendingCategory.title: SpendingCategory

SpendingPhases.description: Multipliers on base spending by the reference member's age (e.g. go-go / slow-go / no-go years).
SpendingPhases.title: SpendingPhases

StateDependentCareCredit.description: A state care credit computed like the federal one (on federal AGI) with its own caps and rate table.
StateDependentCareCredit.title: StateDependentCareCredit

StateTaxDoc.description: Income tax rules per state, keyed by code (e.g. "WI"). A household's `state` picks one; "none" is required.
StateTaxDoc.title: StateTaxDoc

SuccessCriteria.description: A path succeeds when every enabled criterion holds in every simulated year.
SuccessCriteria.title: SuccessCriteria

SweepTarget.description: Where year-end surplus cash goes, in priority order.
SweepTarget.title: SweepTarget

TargetDateStrategy.description: Allocation follows a glide path toward `target_year`. Glide path fields may be overridden inline.
TargetDateStrategy.title: TargetDateStrategy

TaxableIncome.description: How a taxable account's return splits into current income vs. price change. Cash returns are all interest.
TaxableIncome.title: TaxableIncome

TraditionalIraDeduction.description: Deduction phase-outs when covered by a workplace plan.
TraditionalIraDeduction.title: TraditionalIraDeduction
